notes.title: Sky to Fly: Soulless Leviathan is more than ordinary runner
notes.content:
We need your support to get Sky to Fly: Soulless Leviathan passed on Steam Greenlight.
Now it is faster than wind and even faster that light.

[url=http://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=642869079]
[img]https://absolutist.com/online/Scr31.jpg[/img]
[/url]

What is expected in Soulless Leviathan:

- More battles and fire  
- Ability to blast a lot 
- Much more exploring
- Strike a shattering blow to Robot

Vote for Sky to Fly: Soulless Leviathan on Steam Greenlight.
